name: Utah Summer Open 2020
information:
# The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* No outside food and drink.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with much of the information you need.
* If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM.
